item.title: Iran warns against ‘baseless’ nuclear allegations amid silence over US-Israeli war of aggression
item.description: New York, IRNA — Iran’s Ambassador and Chargé d’Affaires to the United Nations, Gholamhossein Darzi, has expressed deep concern over baseless allegations leveled by certain countries against Iran’s peaceful nuclear program, while maintaining silence over the illegal and unjustified US-Israeli war.

item.title: Army spokesperson: Strait of Hormuz will only be reopened by accepting Iran’s conditions
item.description: Bandar Abbas, IRNA — An Iranian Army spokesperson asserted the Armed Forces’ complete dominance over the Strait of Hormuz, saying the reopening of this strategic waterway depends on the US accepting Iran’s conditions. He added that any renewed aggression by the enemy would be met with an immediate, overwhelming response that extends beyond the region’s geographical borders.

item.title: Araghchi stresses increasing the level of economic engagement with ECO member states
item.description: Islamabad, IRNA — Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in a meeting with his Pakistani counterpart, Ishaq Dar, while expressing appreciation for Pakistan’s gracious hospitality and the successful hosting of the 30th meeting of the Council of Ministers of the Economic Cooperation Organization (ECO), emphasized the strengthening of multilateral cooperation, the enhancement of economic and commercial engagement, and the expansion of coordination among member states.
